unit_note: Reference prices are USD per 1000 billable units. Text observations are token-like units; media_transcode uses the separately documented media_work_units = input_bytes/4 geometry; media_rendering uses declared output pixels because the measured renderer is pixel/sec. Media observations below convert official per-minute prices using the measured 320x180/0.208333s reference fixture (430.5 media_work_units); this is a market comparison only, while the fixed-point quote/settlement geometry remains the control authority.
positioning_note: Catalogue reference price = confidence-weighted median of governed class observations × positioning_multiplier. Vendor-owned sources carry more weight than third-party or unattributed rows; 0.9 positions the result 10% below that governed median.

embed_small.description: Small general-purpose text embeddings (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small class / voyage-4-lite class). Maps to all-minilm-l6-v2.

observations.notes: Standard tier; batch is ~$0.01/1M. Used as the open-web list price for small embeddings.

infer_small.description: Small open-weight chat/completion (≤~3B / 1B-class Llama). Maps to llama-3.2-1b-instruct-q4.

observations.notes: Cited Fireworks Llama 3.2 1B Instruct at $0.01 / 1M input and output.

media_transcode_small.description: Bounded short-form video transcode comparable to a small SD/HD normalisation job. Maps to ffmpeg-transcode-v1 and prices the documented media_work_units geometry.

observations.notes: Official $0.015/output minute SD rate converted for the measured 0.208333-second, 430.5-media_work_unit reference fixture; no claim that provider billing uses Merc's unit.

Official $0.10/video-minute encoding price converted for the measured reference fixture; used as a high-side corroborating market observation, not as a supplier cost floor.

media_rendering_small.description: Bounded deterministic vector-scene rasterization. Market observations are intentionally absent; the fixed price is a private-canary economic term, not an image-generation benchmark.

observations.notes: Private deterministic renderer term; not an external image-generation market observation and not public activation authority.
